subject: [PATCH v5 08/19] selftests/mm: add folio-order check for address ranges

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called is_range_backed_by_order() to the selftests/mm module, which checks if a given address range is backed by folios of a specific order. The function verifies that every folio-sized, folio-aligned part of the range maps one folio of the target order, head to tail, with the head at the start of the part. This patch addresses a limitation in existing functions such as is_backed_by_folio() and check_huge_anon(), which only account for single-page or PMD mappings, respectively. The new function will be used by an mTHP collapse test to determine if a range is backed by folios of the target order, allowing it to distinguish between collapsed and non-collapsed ranges.
